note: P4370 (Pro 30:17) — the eye that mocks a father and scorns a mother will be picked out by ravens.

dims.v: filial derision — the eye that mocks its father
the mocking of a father with the eye — the derision of a parent that, with scorn for a mother's authority, draws a terrible judgement, contempt for the parents who gave one life
the scorn of the mother it is joined with (267134)
welded to the scorning of a mother's authority

laag (mock/deride) — 'the eye that MOCKS a father' (30:17); to deride one's father is a grievous impiety, judged with horror (the corpse left for ravens). Contempt for parents is contempt for the source of one's life (cf 30:11; 20:20).
filial contempt — scorning obedience to a mother
the scorning to obey a mother — the contempt for maternal authority that, with mockery of a father, marks the rebellious child on whom a fearful judgement falls
the mockery of the father it is joined with (267132)
welded to the eye that mocks a father
buz (despise/scorn) — 'and SCORNS to obey a mother' (30:17); contempt for a mother's authority, twin to mockery of a father, brings terrible judgement. To scorn the parents is to invite ruin.
